name: Form
intent: One form: an optional title, kit fields (or titled sections of them) and the actions that save it.
usage: Use Form to wrap kit fields (Input, Textarea, Select, DatePicker, FormulaEditor, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch) that save together. Read-only values go in FormDisplay rows; back-to-back rows sit flush as one list. Pass the fields as children, or as sections when they fall into groups like Company and Billing; each section is a titled group. labelPosition="start" puts every field's label in a column at the beginning; columns={2} puts fields side by side. actions holds kit Buttons: secondary first, one primary last with type="submit". Enter in a field submits, and onSubmit gets the values by field name. Inside a Modal, skip the title (the Modal names it), give the Form an id, and put the Save Button in the Modal footer with form set to that id. See contracts/form.json for the full contract.

title.note: 18px heading. It names the form for screen readers. Skip it inside a Modal.

description.note: One line under the title. Read with the form.

variant.note: plain sits on the page. card is a bordered panel with a faint footer, like a settings block.

labelPosition.note: Where the kit fields inside put their label. start puts it in a 160px column at the beginning; Checkbox, Switch and RadioGroup line up with the fields. A field's own labelPosition still wins.

columns.note: 2 puts fields side by side, left to right. A Textarea spans both. Drops to one column when the form is narrow (under 560px, or 720px with start labels).

children.note: The kit fields, top to bottom. Use this or sections, not both.

sections.itemShape: { title: string; description?: string; content: ReactNode }
sections.note: Titled groups of fields with a line between them. Each is a fieldset named by its title.

actions.note: Kit Buttons at the end: secondary first, one primary last with type="submit". Size sm in a card.

error.note: A problem with the whole form, like a failed save. Shows as a danger Alert above the fields. Field problems go on the field's own error.

onSubmit.note: (data: FormData) => void. The page never reloads. Required fields must be filled first.

id.note: Lets a Button outside the form submit it, like a Modal footer Button with form={id}.

useWhen: Fields that save together, like company details or billing settings.
A settings page split into titled groups.
The body of an edit or invite Modal.
doNot: Do not invent FieldSet, FieldGroup, FieldLegend, FormSection, FormActions or a local <form> wrapper.
Do not put a Form inside another Form.
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions.
Do not wrap a single RadioGroup in a section. It already has its own legend.
Do not show field errors in error. Put them on the field.
a11y: A native form element, named by its title and described by its description.
Each section is a fieldset whose legend is its title; the section description is read with it.
error is a danger Alert, announced when it appears.
Enter in a field submits. Native required checks run before onSubmit.
snippet:
<Form
  title="Company details"
  onSubmit={save}
  actions={<>
    <Button onClick={cancel}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="primary" type="submit">Save</Button>
  </>}
>
  <Input label="Company" name="company" required />
  <Input label="Billing email" name="email" type="email" />
</Form>
